primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Initial responders are defined as participants who showed a ½ log or greater reduction in their serum HBsAg levels from baseline to Day 71 ± 3 days of the primary Heparc-2002 and Heparc-2003 studies, where baseline is defined as the average of pre-dose values.

groups.description: ARC-520 2.0 mg/kg administered by IV infusion to participants previously enrolled in the Heparc-2002 study and receiving ARC-520 1.0 mg/kg. Participants continued their ongoing entecavir therapy (0.5 or 1.0 mg/day) or tenofovir therapy (300 mg/day).
groups.title: Heparc-2002: ARC-520 1.0 mg/kg

groups.description: ARC-520 2.0 mg/kg administered by IV infusion to participants previously enrolled in the Heparc-2002 study and receiving ARC-520 2.0 mg/kg. Participants continued their ongoing entecavir therapy (0.5 or 1.0 mg/day) or tenofovir therapy (300 mg/day).
groups.title: Heparc-2002: ARC-520 2.0 mg/kg

groups.description: ARC-520 2.0 mg/kg administered by IV infusion to participants previously enrolled in the Heparc-2003 study and receiving ARC-520 2.0 mg/kg. Participants continued their ongoing entecavir therapy (0.5 or 1.0 mg/day) or tenofovir therapy (300 mg/day).
groups.title: Heparc-2003: ARC-520 2.0 mg/kg

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The study was terminated prior to any participant reaching Week 36 of treatment; therefore, this outcome measure could not be analyzed.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Percentage of Initial Responders to ARC-520 Therapy Achieving a 1-log Reduction in HBsAg at Week 36 Compared to Baseline
